decisions.reason: As a 2023 extension of the core spraying line that remained on the website through 2024, it fits existing capabilities and gives management enough basis to justify continued commitment rather than exit.

Its dedicated product page across 2023 and 2024 signals visible public commitment, and as a close-to-core injection pump management would be inclined to continue after development and field-test investments.

Because it builds on the established offer and explicitly reuses proven air-motor technology, disappointing uptake could easily be framed as temporary while the sunk engineering effort favors persistence.
With its own page in both years and clear relevance to the firm's push toward more future-oriented and interoperable customer solutions, management would be likely to stay the course.
Having only launched in 2024 and being close to the established business, it is too early for management to abandon a recent investment that can still be defended as needing more time in the market.
